meta.name: app-store-screenshots
meta.description: App Store and Google Play screenshot creation with exact platform specs. Covers iOS/Android dimensions, gallery ordering, device mockups, and preview videos. Use for: app store optimization, ASO, app screenshots, app preview, play store listing. Triggers: app store screenshots, aso, app store optimization, play store screenshots, app preview, app listing, ios screenshots, android screenshots, app store images, app mockup, device mockup, app gallery, store listing

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按平台规格自动生成应用商店截图和预览视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为App Store和Google Play批量制作符合规格的截图
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate app store screenshots and preview videos with exact platform specs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch create platform-compliant screenshots for App Store and Google Play

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据 App Store 和 Google Play 的精确规格生成应用截图和预览视频，包括尺寸、设备模型、图库排序和文案建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“应用商店截图”、“ASO”、“应用预览”等关键词，或要求制作 iOS/Android 截图时触发。

say.text: 为我的记账应用设计前三张截图，突出核心价值。
say.note: Claude 会按“前三张规则”提供布局和文案建议。

say.text: 生成一个 30 秒的应用预览视频脚本，包含钩子和三个功能演示。
say.note: Claude 会输出视频结构建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate app store screenshots and preview videos with exact platform specs for App Store and Google Play, including dimensions, device mockups, gallery ordering, and caption writing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'app store screenshots', 'ASO', 'app preview', or ask to create iOS/Android screenshots.

say_en.text: Generate an iPhone 15 Pro fitness app screenshot at 1290x2796.
say_en.note: Claude will use tools to create a spec-compliant screenshot.

say_en.text: Design the first three screenshots for my budgeting app, highlighting core value.
say_en.note: Claude will follow the first-3 rule for layout and captions.

say_en.text: Create a 30-second app preview video script with hook and three feature demos.
say_en.note: Claude will output a video structure suggestion.
